candidates.name: Makgadikgadi Pans (Ntwetwe and Sua pans)
candidates.why_include: Strong, literature-supported Mars playa analogue with basin-scale geomorphology and recent shallow-subsurface GPR work. It can serve as a positive-control case when assessing whether the scoring pipeline recognizes established analog settings.
known_mismatches: episodic liquid water and active biology
local hydrology and sediment chemistry differ from Mars
not a current-day Mars climate analog

candidates.name: Lake Magadi and surrounding soda-lake evaporites
candidates.why_include: A regionally distinctive and comparatively underused candidate in the brief's framing. Published work documents unusual evaporite minerals and satellite hyperspectral mapping, making it useful for a data-backed mineral/remote-sensing study. The analog claim should be restricted to aqueous alteration and evaporite processes, not broad environmental similarity.
known_mismatches: hyperalkaline brines and hot springs are unlike most target surface conditions
no match to lunar vacuum, gravity, or radiation

candidates.name: Harrat Khaybar volcanic field
candidate_for: roughness and slope for mobility testing
candidates.why_include: A large basaltic volcanic field outside the brief's familiar examples. Include as an exploratory screening candidate for landform and mobility comparisons; do not describe it as an established astronaut-training analog without field validation and literature review.
known_mismatches: Earth weathering, atmosphere, gravity, and biological cover
geochemistry and eruption conditions are not identical to lunar or Martian volcanism
global DEM resolution cannot resolve all hazards or block-scale roughness
